summary_md: **Tencent Hy ([@TencentHunyuan](https://x.com/TencentHunyuan/status/2115851165904814283))** releases the technical report for **Hy-Nomas**, a free-form interactive world-generation model ([arXiv 2610.36729](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36729)), open-sources Hy-Nomas-Bench ([dataset](https://huggingface.co/datasets/tencent/Hy-Nomas-Bench)), compares it with Genie 4 and offers a demo with no waitlist ([demo](https://hy-nomas.hy.tencent.com/)).

referenced_urls.title: Hy-Nomas: Towards Free-form Interactive World Generation

relevance: Interactive world models for agentic media.
